description.en: Specifies whether the window is enabled or disabled.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页行数。最大值为100。默认值：当不设置值或设置的值小于10时，默认值为10。当设置的值大于100时，默认值为100。
description.en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: If the value is not specified or is less than 10, the default value is 10. If the value is greater than 100, the default value is 100.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

description.en: The region ID of the instance. You can call DescribeRegions to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 运维窗口生效的资源组 ID
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the O&M window applies.
The tags to which the O&M window applies.

descriptions.zh:
查询已设定的维护策略，策略中主要包括两个维护属性。

- 维护时间窗口：您指定的一个时间段，运维只会在该时间内进行。
- 维护动作：您指定的实例宕机处理策略。
descriptions.en:
Queries the configured maintenance policies. Each policy contains two maintenance attributes:

- Maintenance time window: A time period you specify during which O&M operations are performed.
- Maintenance action: The instance downtime handling policy you specify.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-plan-maintenance-windows --enable true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --plan-window-id pw-bp1jarob1aup7yvlrdt6 --plan-window-name WIndowName --target-resource-group-id rg-d85g5yocioezmdrll --target-resource-tags Value=tagValue Key=tagKey --next-token AAAAAdDWBF2 --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
